record.question: How will you regulate the traveling allowance claim in the following circumstances? (Answer any three): (a) A Government servant stationed at a place where there is no medical officer is required to perform a journey to obtain medical certificate. (b) An officer and his wife, who is also a Government servant, are both transferred at the same time from the same station to the same new station. (c) A retired Government servant is required to perform a journey to attend departmental inquiry instituted against him. (d) A Government servant is required to perform a journey to attend an obligatory departmental examination.
